On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.
And they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gerasenes.
他們來到海那邊格拉森人的地方。
As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.
And when he had got out of the boat, straight away there came to him from the place of the dead a man with an unclean spirit.
耶穌一下船，就有一個被污鬼附著的人從墳塋裡出來迎著他。
This man had been living in the tombs and could no longer be restrained, even with chains.
He was living in the place of the dead: and no man was able to keep him down, no, not with a chain;
那人常住在墳塋裡，沒有人能捆住他，就是用鐵鍊也不能；
Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.
Because he had frequently been prisoned in chains and iron bands, and the chains had been parted and the bands broken by him: and no man was strong enough to make him quiet.
因為人屢次用腳鐐和鐵鍊捆鎖他，鐵鍊竟被他掙斷了，腳鐐也被他弄碎了；總沒有人能制伏他。
Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
And all the time, by day and by night, in the place of the dead, and in the mountains, he was crying out and cutting himself with stones.
他晝夜常在墳塋裡和山中喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。
When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
And when he saw Jesus from far off, he went quickly to him and gave him worship;
他遠遠地看見耶穌，就跑過去拜他，
And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”
And crying out with a loud voice he said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God's name, do not be cruel to me.
大聲呼叫說：「至高神的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？我指著神懇求你，不要叫我受苦！」
For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
For Jesus had said to him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit.
是因耶穌曾吩咐他說：「污鬼啊，從這人身上出來吧！」
“What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
And Jesus said, What is your name? And he made answer, My name is Legion, because there are a great number of us.
耶穌問他說：「你名叫甚麼？」回答說：「我名叫『群』，因為我們多的緣故」；
And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.
And he made strong prayers to him not to send them away out of the country.
就再三地求耶穌，不要叫他們離開那地方。
There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
Now on the mountain side there was a great herd of pigs getting their food.
在那裡山坡上，有一大群豬吃食；
So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
And they said to him, Send us into the pigs, so that we may go into them.
鬼就央求耶穌說：「求你打發我們往豬群裡，附著豬去。」
He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.

And he let them do it. And the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs; and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the sea, about two thousand of them; and they came to their death in the sea.
耶穌准了他們，污鬼就出來，進入豬裡去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在海裡，淹死了。豬的數目約有二千。
Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
And their keepers went running and gave an account of it in the town and in the country. And people came to see what had taken place.
放豬的就逃跑了，去告訴城裡和鄉下的人。眾人就來，要看是甚麼事。
When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
And they came to Jesus, and saw the man in whom had been the evil spirits seated, clothed and with full use of his senses, and they were full of fear.
他們來到耶穌那裡，看見那被鬼附著的人，就是從前被群鬼所附的，坐著，穿上衣服，心裡明白過來，他們就害怕。
Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.
And those who had seen it gave them an account of what had been done to him who had the evil spirits, and of the fate of the pigs.
看見這事的，便將鬼附之人所遇見的和那群豬的事都告訴了眾人；
And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.
And they made a request to him to go out of their country.
眾人就央求耶穌離開他們的境界。
As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.
And when he was getting into the boat, the man in whom had been the evil spirits had a great desire to come with him.
耶穌上船的時候，那從前被鬼附著的人懇求和耶穌同在。
But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”
And he would not let him, but said to him, Go to your house, to your friends, and give them news of the great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.
耶穌不許，卻對他說：「你回家去，到你的親屬那裡，將主為你所做的是何等大的事，是怎樣憐憫你，都告訴他們。」
So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.
And he went on his way, and made public in the country of Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him: and all men were full of wonder.
那人就走了，在低加坡里傳揚耶穌為他做了何等大的事，眾人就都希奇。
When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
And when Jesus had gone over again in the boat to the other side, a great number of people came to him: and he was by the sea.
耶穌坐船又渡到那邊去，就有許多人到他那裡聚集；他正在海邊上。
A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
And one of the rulers of the Synagogue, Jairus by name, came, and seeing him, went down at his feet,
有一個管會堂的人，名叫睚魯，來見耶穌，就俯伏在他腳前，
and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
And made strong prayers to him, saying, My little daughter is near to death: it is my prayer that you will come and put your hands on her, so that she may be made well, and have life.
再三地求他，說：「我的小女兒快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她痊癒，得以活了。」
So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.
And he went with him; and a great number of people went after him, and came round him.
耶穌就和他同去。有許多人跟隨擁擠他。
And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
And a woman, who had had a flow of blood for twelve years,
有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，
She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
And had undergone much at the hands of a number of medical men, and had given all she had, and was no better, but even worse,
在好些醫生手裡受了許多的苦，又花盡了她所有的，一點也不見好，病勢反倒更重了。
When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
When she had news of the things which Jesus did, went among the people coming after him, and put her hand on his robe.
她聽見耶穌的事，就從後頭來，雜在眾人中間，摸耶穌的衣裳，
For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
For she said, If I may only put my hand on his robe, I will be made well.
意思說：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊癒。」
Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
And straight away the fountain of her blood was stopped, and she had a feeling in her body that her disease had gone and she was well.
於是她血漏的源頭立刻乾了；她便覺得身上的災病好了。
At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
And straight away Jesus was conscious that power had gone out of him; and, turning to the people, he said, Who was touching my robe?
耶穌頓時心裡覺得有能力從自己身上出去，就在眾人中間轉過來，說：「誰摸我的衣裳？」
His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”
And his disciples said to him, You see the people round you on every side, and you say, Who was touching me?
門徒對他說：「你看眾人擁擠你，還說『誰摸我』嗎？」
But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
And on his looking round to see her who had done this thing,
耶穌周圍觀看，要見做這事的女人。
Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
The woman, shaking with fear, conscious of what had been done to her, came and, falling on her face before him, gave him a true account of everything.
那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐懼戰兢，來俯伏在耶穌跟前，將實情全告訴他。
“Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
And he said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be free from your disease.
耶穌對她說：「女兒，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧！你的災病痊癒了。」
While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”
And while he was still talking, they came from the ruler of the Synagogue's house, saying, Your daughter is dead: why are you still troubling the Master?
還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裡來，說：「你的女兒死了，何必還勞動先生呢？」
But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”
But Jesus, giving no attention to their words, said to the ruler of the Synagogue, Have no fear, only have faith.
耶穌聽見所說的話，就對管會堂的說：「不要怕，只要信！」
And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
And he did not let anyone come with him, but Peter and James and John, the brother of James.
於是帶著彼得、雅各、和雅各的兄弟約翰同去，不許別人跟隨他。
When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
And they came to the house of the ruler of the Synagogue; and he saw people running this way and that, and weeping and crying loudly.
他們來到管會堂的家裡；耶穌看見那裡亂嚷，並有人大大地哭泣哀號，
He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”
And when he had gone in, he said to them, Why are you making such a noise and weeping? The child is not dead, but sleeping.
進到裡面，就對他們說：「為甚麼亂嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡著了。」
And they laughed at Him. After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.
And they were laughing at him. But he, having sent them all out, took the father of the child and her mother and those who were with him, and went in where the child was.
他們就嗤笑耶穌。耶穌把他們都攆出去，就帶著孩子的父母和跟隨的人進了孩子所在的地方，
Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
And taking her by the hand, he said to her, Talitha cumi, which is, My child, I say to you, Get up.
就拉著孩子的手，對她說：「大利大，古米！」（翻出來就是說：「閨女，我吩咐你起來！」）
Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around. She was twelve years old, and at once they were utterly astounded.
And the young girl got up straight away, and was walking about; she being twelve years old. And they were overcome with wonder.
那閨女立時起來走。他們就大大地驚奇；閨女已經十二歲了。
Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
And he gave them special orders that they were not to say anything of this; and he said that some food was to be given to her.
耶穌切切地囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給她東西吃。
